enchantments.tooltip: Strength +7: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Deadly +6: +6 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Stunning +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Seeker +7: Provides a +7 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +7 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
